title: Country Music Lyrics
text:
Data source: TidyTuesday - Week 34, 2026, curated by Ntokebo Sosibo.
The following bar graph looks at artists with 10 or more songs that reached the Country Top 30 from 2013-2019 and the proportion of those songs that contained the word “beer” in their lyrics.


Show the code
wordmentions <- country_lyrics |>
    mutate(beer = str_detect(lyrics, "beer")) |>
    group_by(artist) |>
    summarize(
        number = n(),
        pct_beer = mean(beer, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    filter(number>=10) 

ggplot(data = wordmentions, aes(x = artist, y = pct_beer)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
        x = "Artist", 
        y = "Percent of songs that mention beer",
        title = "Beer mentions by artists for \nTop 30 country songs,  2013-2019")

title: Amazon Annual Reports
text:
Data source: TidyTuesday - Week 12 2025, curated by Gregory Vander Vinne
The following graph shows the frequency of five common sustainability “buzzwords” in Amazon’s annual reports from 2005 to 2023. Environment includes both “environment” and “environmental”, and sustainable includes both “sustainable” and “sustainability.”


Show the code
buzzwords <- report_words_clean |>
    mutate(
        sustainable = str_detect(word, "sustainab"),
        environment = str_detect(word, "environment"),
        climate = str_detect(word, "climate"),
        carbon = str_detect(word, "carbon"),
        emissions = str_detect(word, "emission")
    ) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(across(sustainable:emissions, sum)) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "word", values_to = "n")

ggplot(data = buzzwords, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = word)) +
    labs(
        x = "Year",
        y = "Number of occurances",
        title = "Frequency of sustainability buzzwords \n in Amazon annual reports, 2005-2023",
        color = "Buzzword"
    )
